activities.activity_description: Rerun baseline, Tuple, and Serialized payloads to compare performance between Kafka 0.8.1 and 0.8.2 across specified sinks (In-Memory, HDFS Direct Binding, HDFS Kafka, HDFS Sink).
Upgrade the Reactor dependency to version 2.0.3, run existing tests to ensure compatibility, and verify performance improvements.
Change the default configuration to turn off JMX, update relevant documentation, and verify performance throughput benefits.
Fix outstanding build issues with local ./gradlew dist and distZip targets to ensure publish builds work as expected.
Clean-up compiler and javadoc warnings from the build to ensure a clean sysout.
Update RPM scripts to allow starting multiple instances of xd-container on the same node/VM, including port and instance management.
Update documentation to refer to Out-Of-The-Box (OOTB) batch jobs, allowing users to jump to the right job section and review details.
Update documentation for the analytics tab to help users understand how to use various widgets from the streaming pipeline.
